# hetznerrobot_ips (Data Source)

Lists the single IP addresses of the account, or of one server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The IPs of one server; leave server_ip out for the whole account.
data "hetznerrobot_ips" "web" {
  server_ip = "123.123.123.123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `server_ip` (String) Main IP address of a server; only its IPs are listed.

### Read-Only

- `ips` (Attributes List) The IP addresses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ips))

<a id="nestedatt--ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ips`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) The IP address.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the IP is locked.
- `separate_mac` (String) Separate MAC address, if one is set.
- `server_ip` (String) Main IP address of the server the IP belongs to.
- `server_number` (Number) Server the IP belongs to.
- `traffic_daily` (Number) Daily traffic limit in MB.
- `traffic_hourly` (Number) Hourly traffic limit in MB.
- `traffic_monthly` (Number) Monthly traffic limit in GB.
- `traffic_warnings` (Boolean) Whether Robot sends traffic warnings.
